what: Chapter 15 of the introduction, "Memory: our three brains in Living Brain", as a 5 s loop for the chapter panes: the beat at the site's rest, drawn without its caption, scope line or plates, the camera drifting round its rest pose and back. Positions are schematic, as in the story.
name: Memory: our three brains in Living Brain

code.world: packages/world as the commit holds it

render.command: packages/world: sh scripts/serve.sh <port>; site: WORLD_BROWSER_LIB=<launcher> node scripts/render-chapters.mjs --port <port> --loops shared-memory --seconds 5 --fps 30
render.page: src/story/story.html?mode=capture&cut=master&w=1920&h=1080&captions=none, the player set to the site's stops
render.drawn: 1920 x 1080 CSS px at 1x, Lanczos to each size
render.gpu: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M1 Max, Unspecified Version)

rerender_when: the beat's frame changes (packages/world/src/stations/brain/**, its kit parts or the frame data), or its place in the site's story
